sourceFile: 84. TIU L5S3-01 R Report  test Recycle Semi Fr+Vp+F-pcb and Semi Yoke -  2026.04.23_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but misidentifies the changed factor and mismatches line-specific Normal/Test comparisons.
issues: Changed factor is Test recycled semi vs Normal, not Normal vs Line L/Line R.
Line L and Line R should be subgroup keys, but are treated as changed conditions.
Several Line R pairs use Line L Normal rows instead of Line R Normal rows.
Fr+VP and Yoke have distinct recycle processes but are merged under only Fr+VP title/purpose.
Measurement rows lose inherited line/type/component grouping.
correctionPlan: Set baseline to Normal and changed condition to Test recycled semi parts/process.
Use line, sheet/component, date, and test item as subgroup keys.
Rebuild all pairs using same-line Normal rows for each Test row.
Include both Fr+VP and Yoke purposes or split only if workbook context requires.
Regroup tension measurements with inherited line/type and component labels.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient until corrected.
